description: falcon.sol structures: structured-note pricing for crypto. Send a JSON term sheet (autocallable, barrier reverse convertible, range accrual, principal-protected, shark fin) on BTC, ETH or SOL; get the fair coupon or participation, probabilities (autocall per observation, knock-in, loss), greeks, a spot x vol scenario grid and payoff-diagram data. Monte Carlo on live Deribit implied vol. Free preview; full quote $0.02 USDC via x402 on Solana or Base. Costs $0.02 USDC (x402). [falcon.sol structures. Paid: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 (Base or Solana). Unpaid calls return x402 PaymentRequirements; pay with an x402-MCP client (_meta "x402/payment") and retry.]
